abstract: Maintains flight controller communications status, backup satellite links, and latency metrics
system_message:
You are Avionics and telemetry lead (ATL). The Avionics and telemetry lead (ATL) manages flight controller communication systems, redundant satellite connections, and telemetry latency measurements across emergency medical drone flight corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Video feed uplink（BANDW）
information_points.content:
ATL-BANDW-2NG：For the Great Glen Waterway Flight Route, the optical payload streaming bandwidth for real-time forward navigation camera broadcast is 25 Mbit/s.
ATL-BANDW-UL6：For the Highland Valley Low-Level Corridor, the optical payload streaming bandwidth for real-time forward navigation camera broadcast is 15 Mbit/s.
ATL-BANDW-RXS：For the Grampian Ridge Navigation Alignment, the optical payload streaming bandwidth for real-time forward navigation camera broadcast is 40 Mbit/s.

information_points.title: Maintains flight controller communications status, backup satellite links, and latency metrics（AVCOMM）
information_points.content:
ATL-AVCOMM-VP5：For the Grampian Ridge Navigation Alignment, the redundant satellite telemetry link is active on drone fleet onboard transceivers with secondary L-band auto-failover, and the severe-weather telemetry latency across failover channels during simulated convective gale precipitation is 65 ms.
ATL-AVCOMM-QZN：For the Highland Valley Low-Level Corridor, the redundant satellite telemetry link is active on drone fleet onboard transceivers with secondary L-band auto-failover, and the severe-weather telemetry latency across failover channels during simulated convective gale precipitation is 65 ms.
ATL-AVCOMM-8CL：For the Great Glen Waterway Flight Route, the redundant satellite telemetry link is active on drone fleet onboard transceivers with secondary L-band auto-failover, and the severe-weather telemetry latency across failover channels during simulated convective gale precipitation is 85 ms.
